meta.unbuilt: A service RFQ. the API set-up does not build service events yet

plan.title: Service RFQ vendor bid across all activities

steps.note: Open the existing prepared service RFQ rather than creating a new event.
Sign in through the vendor portal as the next configured vendor and submit rates for the RFQ activities.
Verify the vendor portal accepted the submitted bid.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after the vendor bid.
Verify every activity's amount equals rate multiplied by activity quantity and the buyer's total equals the sum of the activity amounts.
